def test_add():
    # Empty list -> no elements, sum is 0
    assert add([]) == 0

    # Single element list -> no odd indices exist
    assert add([2]) == 0

    # Standard case: odd indices are 1, 3 -> values 2, 4 (both even) -> 6
    assert add([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) == 6

    # Odd-indexed elements are all odd -> nothing added
    assert add([1, 3, 5, 7]) == 0

    # All odd-indexed elements even
    assert add([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 4

    # Mixed: only even values at odd indices count
    # indices 1,3,5 -> 2 (even), 5 (odd), 4 (even) -> 6
    assert add([0, 2, 9, 5, 0, 4]) == 6

    # Longer list: indices 1,3,5,7 -> 2,4,6,8 -> 20
    assert add([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]) == 20

    # Negative even numbers at odd indices
    assert add([-2, -4, -6, -8]) == -12

    # Zeros at odd indices (0 is even)
    assert add([1, 0, 3, 0]) == 0

    # Even value at last (odd) index should be included
    assert add([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 6

    # Large numbers
    assert add([1, 1000000, 1, 2000000]) == 3000000

# Unit test for function add
def test_add():
    # Typical case: even values at odd indices
    assert add([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 6          # 2 + 4
    assert add([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) == 12   # 2 + 4 + 6
    assert add([5, 0, 5, 4]) == 4          # 0 + 4

    # Odd values at odd indices contribute nothing
    assert add([1, 3, 5, 7]) == 0
    assert add([2, 1]) == 0                # value at odd index is odd

    # Even values at even indices are ignored
    assert add([2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]) == 0
    assert add([4, 1]) == 0

    # Empty and single-element lists
    assert add([]) == 0
    assert add([2]) == 0                   # no odd index exists
    assert add([0]) == 0

    # Zeros are even
    assert add([1, 0, 1, 0]) == 0          # 0 + 0
    assert add([0, 0, 0, 0]) == 0

    # Negative numbers
    assert add([-1, -2, -3, -4]) == -6     # -2 + -4
    assert add([-1, -3]) == 0              # odd value at odd index
    assert add([-2, -3]) == 0              # even value at even index

    # Larger example
    assert add([10, 21, 30, 44, 51, 62]) == 106  # 44 + 62

    print("All test_add tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_add()
